quest.title: The Entrance to Tokoyo
quest.description: After passing through The Moon-Bathed Deep, you come to a land that is foreign to you. You see no sign of any civilization at all, and so you decide to investigate further.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

chapter.title: From Dusk to Dawn in Byakuyakoku

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew, it sure took a while before we saw anything resembling civilization. Let's get closer and have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The five symbols on this big door must be the Key Sigils.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's have a look around. From what we've experienced in the past, we'll probably need to do something else first.

talks.objective: Go to the building up ahead

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! Paimon never thought that there'd be such a huge place underneath Watatsumi Island!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like our goal is that place in the middle.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alrighty then, {NICKNAME}. Let's head in. Steadily now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Those ruins seem to be closer to us. Let's start there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Buildings means people... once upon a time, anyway. And where there's people, there'll be writing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And where there's writing and paper, there'll be those... hints that we can't even read.

talks.objective: Investigate the nearby area and search for clues
Investigate the nearby area and search for clues
Investigate the nearby area and search for clues
Investigate the nearby area and search for clues
Investigate the nearby area and search for clues
Investigate the mechanism and activate the gate

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like there's something else visible through this door. Is it a path? Or is it a trap that'll make us bump into a wall?

talks.objective: Examine the great gate and look for a way to progress

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so there really was a path here. Enkanomiya is such a mysterious place.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like this is where we need to use the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep.

talks.objective: Use the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep to open the door
